Starlink is bringing high-speed internet to thousands of students in rural Honduras, one school at a time 🇭🇳

At Escuela Sergio Palacios in El Hatillo, 200 students now have access to Starlink internet through an installation by Conatel

And this is part of a much bigger effort to connect underserved communities

• 1,212 institutions connected through Conatel's wider connectivity program, benefiting over 167,500 students
• 1,860 Starlink antennas installed by Hondutel across 218 municipalities
• 3,100 Starlink installations planned in total
• Over 2,000 additional schools, health centers and public institutions targeted for connectivity in 2027

For students growing up in remote communities, having internet access opens up an entirely new world of opportunities to learn, research and access educational resources that were previously out of reach

This is what makes Starlink so important

US colleges are seeing another sharp drop in international students.

New international student enrollment fell 15% this fall, the third straight annual decline, per a preliminary Institute of International Education survey of more than 800 schools, reported by Bloomberg. Total international enrollment fell 9%.

The drop is steepest among graduate students, down 15%, compared with 3% for undergraduates. Last academic year, master’s enrollment plunged 22%.

I think the Fed is about to make another mistake on December 9th. Financial conditions have tightened massively. For example, @SpaceX, an investment grade company, just raised secured debt financing at an 8.259% interest rate versus below 6% for its unsecured bond offering at the time of its IPO. 

The cost of equity capital has also increased materially with the recent substantial decline in the stock market. 

The Fed’s 2% inflation ambition is misguided. Geopolitical risk and the required investment in global military spending, de globalization and tariffs, and the massive AI infrastructure and related energy investment are features of the world that did not exist when the 2% target was set. 3% inflation is a more realistic ambition in the new world. 

The Fed will put the U.S. and world in recession if it continues to raise rates in a failed attempt to drive inflation to 2%. 

Tell me why I am wrong.

Around 50 migrant youths attacked a traditional Krampus parade with stones in Ansfelden, Upper Austria, injuring three people and forcing the event to be canceled early.

More than 1,000 spectators had gathered to watch the traditional Austrian Christmas-season procession.

A 16-year-old participant was grabbed by the horns of his Krampus mask and violently pulled downward, requiring treatment at a hospital. Another participant, aged 15, was pushed from behind and injured his left knee.

29.3% of Ansfelden’s residents were foreign nationals in 2024, while an April 2026 report from the Upper Austrian government indicated that 37.8% of the town’s population was of non-German-speaking origin.
